_doc: Golden JSON fixture for NodeStarted event in legacy/OFF mode (SAGE_STATECORE unset or '0'). Pinned by tests/test_runtime_event_contracts.py to enforce byte-identical R5 schema in legacy mode.
_notes: OFF-mode NodeStarted MUST NOT carry predecessors_by_channel.
byte-identical R5 schema guarantee is the hardest invariant to keep — adding a sample line here:
any new optional NodeStarted field added in future tickets MUST be opt-in via SAGE_STATECORE or a similar explicit flag, NEVER unconditional.
